description: Source code for the Windows DHCP PAC file adapter fetcher in Chromium, handling DHCP queries to retrieve PAC URLs via Windows API and managing fetch operations.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Handles DHCP-based PAC URL fetching on Windows, including DHCP API interaction and fetch management.

classes.name: DhcpQuery
classes.description: Encapsulates DHCP query logic for retrieving PAC URL.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Initiates DHCP query and PAC URL fetch process.

methods.name: DidFinish
methods.description: Checks if fetch process has completed.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns the result code of the fetch operation.

methods.name: GetPacURL
methods.description: Returns the PAC URL obtained from DHCP.

methods.name: GetPacURLForAdapter
methods.description: Performs DHCP query for specified network adapter.

methods.name: ImplGetPacURLFromDhcp
methods.description: Static method to retrieve PAC URL via DHCP API.
